ticket.title: User Authentication and Todo Management Flow
ticket.description:
As a registered user, I want to securely log in, manage my daily tasks, and safely log out.
  Acceptance Criteria:
 Given the user is on the login page, when they enter valid username 'admin' and password 'password123' and click Login, they should see the dashboard and greeting 'Welcome, admin!'
 Given the user is on the login page, when they enter invalid credentials 'admin' and 'wrongpass' and click Login, they should see an error message 'Invalid username or password'
 Given the user is logged into the dashboard, when they type 'Deploy Agentic-mesh' into the task input and click Add Task, the new item should appear in the todo list
 Given the user is on the dashboard, when they click Logout, they should be redirected back to the login screen

testCases.title: Valid login displays dashboard greeting
testCases.criterion: Given the user is on the login page, when they enter valid username 'admin' and password 'password123' and click Login, they should see the dashboard and greeting 'Welcome, admin!'
testCases.expectedOutcome: Dashboard is displayed and greeting text 'Welcome, admin!' is visible

testCases.title: Invalid login shows error message
testCases.criterion: Given the user is on the login page, when they enter invalid credentials 'admin' and 'wrongpass' and click Login, they should see an error message 'Invalid username or password'
testCases.expectedOutcome: Error message 'Invalid username or password' is displayed

testCases.title: Add new task appears in todo list
testCases.criterion: Given the user is logged into the dashboard, when they type 'Deploy Agentic-mesh' into the task input and click Add Task, the new item should appear in the todo list
testCases.expectedOutcome: Todo list contains an item with text 'Deploy Agentic-mesh'

testCases.title: Logout returns to login screen
testCases.criterion: Given the user is on the dashboard, when they click Logout, they should be redirected back to the login screen
testCases.expectedOutcome: User is redirected to the login page
